subject: P10 Round 2 Authority Expansion — APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS
body: P10 R2 governance decision: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. CP satisfied all four reconsideration conditions from R1 DEFER. Key registration verified (trust-store.json), JWS signature valid, self-asserted authority field removed, operator concurrence CLAIMED (not independently re-verified). 30-day authority grant with review at expiry. Encoding corruption (mojibake) in stored proposal documented as storage artifact — JWS signature remains valid. Full decision: governance/P10_R2_AUTHORITY_EXPANSION_GOVERNANCE_DECISION_2026-05-18.md
